column2: Revision of Excise Duty under Excise (Special Provisions) Act, No. 13 of 1989

column1: An  Order  made  by  Hon.  Minister  of  Finance,  Planning  and  Economic  Development  under

column3: (Special  Provisions)  Act,  No.  13  of  1989  and  published

column1: Extraordinary  Gazette  Notification  No.  2418/43  dated  January  10,  2025  to  revise  the  Duty
applicable on excisable articles was effective from January 11, 2025.
Accordingly, excise duty on items including motor vehicles and cigarettes increased by 5.9%
as per the inflation-adjusted indexation implemented since 2024.
